newsitem.title: UK: UK construction orders unchanged in 3mths to Oct.
newsitem.headline: UK construction orders unchanged in 3mths to Oct.

text.p: UK new construction orders were unchanged in the three months to October from the previous three but were 2.0 percent higher than in the same three months a year ago, the Department of the Environment said on Tuesday.

New orders in the private housing sector in the three months to October were 27 percent higher compared with the previous three months and 21 percent higher than in the corresponding period a year ago.

Public housing and housing association orders in the latest three months were six percent higher than in the previous three months but eight percent lower than in the same period a year earlier, the DOE said.
Infrastructure orders in the latest three months were eight percent higher than the previous three months and three percent higher compared with the corresponding period a year earlier.
Public non-housing orders (excluding infrastructure) in the latest three months were three percent down on the previous three months and nine per cent up on a year ago.
Private industrial orders in the latest three months were 12 percent higher than in the previous three months but eight percent lower than the same period a year ago.
Private commercial orders in the latest three months were 24 percent below the previous three and eight lower than a year ago.
